title: New story
chooseTitle: How do you want to start?
chooseDesc: Your folder is ready. Do you want to set up your story with the wizard or start writing right away?
completeWizardDesc: Answer the wizard step by step
descriptionPlaceholder: Tell us what your story is about...
structureEmptyDesc: Complete the wizard to define your story's structure.
durationQuestion: How long will your story be?
durationHint: This is a reference — it can evolve over time.
guidedModeQuestion: Do you want a guided mode?
guidedModeHint: We'll ask you step-by-step questions to develop your story's structure.
guidedModeYesDesc: Step-by-step questions to develop your story
guidedEnding: What type of ending do you want?
guidedProtagonistLife: What kind of life will the protagonists have at the end?
guidedProtagonistLifePlaceholder: Describe what the protagonists' life will be like at the end...
guidedEvolution: How did the main character evolve? What did they learn?
guidedEvolutionPlaceholder: Describe the main character's arc from beginning to end...
guidedWorldContext: What is the world or context like at the start of the story?
guidedInitialSituation: What is the initial situation of the story?
guidedInitialSituationPlaceholder: What is happening at the beginning and what triggers it...
guidedCentralTheme: What is the central theme or message of your story?
guidedCentralThemePlaceholder: The idea or reflection running through the whole story...
guidedProblems: What will be the biggest problems they face?
bankHint: Pick extra questions from the bank to complete the story.
bankEmpty: You've answered every question in the bank.
templateQuestion: Which template do you want to use for your structure?
freeStructureQuestion: Which parts do you want to include in your structure?
freeStructureEmpty: Select the parts you want to develop or add custom sections.
completeDesc: You've completed your story's information. You can start writing or keep developing.
infoEmptyDesc: Complete the wizard to add your story's description, genre, characters, and structure.
tagsSuggested: I added tags in the usual fandom style.
tagsNoneNew: I couldn't find any new tags to add.
aiInsufficient: There isn't enough writing in your documents yet. Write more so the AI can fill in the information.
aiApplied: I filled in the details I could extract from your documents.
aiStageSuggested: I left suggestions to improve this stage. Review them and apply the ones that fit.
aiComplete: The wizard information is already complete.
metaEmpty: No data yet. Complete the wizard to add your story's description and details.
fandomsHint: Add multiple if it's a crossover
tagsPlaceholder: e.g. slow burn, enemies to lovers...
structureInicioHint: What is the world and everyday life like before the story starts?
structureDesarrolloHint: What is the inciting incident, and how does it affect the characters?
structureClimaxHint: What is the peak moment and the twist that changes everything?
structureFinalHint: What did they learn? What changed by the end?
structurePromptInicioStatus: What is the world and your characters' everyday life like before the story starts?
structurePromptInicioStatusPh: The status quo: who they are, where they are, what they take for granted...
structurePromptInicioCrack: What already feels tense, incomplete, or about to break, even if nothing has exploded yet?
structurePromptInicioCrackPh: The crack: a rumor, an absence, a rule that no longer holds...
structurePromptDesarrolloInciting: What is the inciting incident: what unites the characters, sets the world in motion, or breaks the status quo?
structurePromptDesarrolloIncitingPh: The news that leaks, the meeting, the mistake, the call they can no longer ignore...
structurePromptDesarrolloEffect: How does that affect the characters, and how does the story start developing?
structurePromptDesarrolloEffectPh: What it does to them, what they decide, what can no longer stay the same...
structurePromptDesarrolloScenes: Which scenes in this section matter, and could evolve later?
structurePromptDesarrolloScenesPh:
chapter: The news leaks
note: How the neighbors find out
structurePromptDesarrolloScenesHint: One scene per line. With AI, they are suggested as a chapter (narrative beats) or a note (world, research), based on what you already wrote.
structurePromptClimaxPeak: What is the peak moment: the plot twist that changes everything?
structurePromptClimaxPeakPh: The reveal, the betrayal, the point of no return...
structurePromptClimaxNow: When are the protagonists in greatest danger and must act NOW? What makes mindsets change, or everything lose its order?
structurePromptClimaxNowPh: The imminent threat, the deadline, the order that breaks...
structurePromptFinalArrive: What questions do you want the ending to arrive at?
structurePromptFinalArrivePh: The questions the ending should answer or leave echoing...
structurePromptFinalChange: What did your characters learn, and what changed?
structurePromptFinalChangePh: The arc, the world made different, what they can no longer un-know...
